name: sol-advisor
description: Sol-led capability router: delegate easy-medium execution to Luna / Max, medium-hard to Terra / High, hard-complex to a separate Sol / High implementer, then require a fresh Sol / High review.

interface.shortDescription: Plan with Sol, route execution across Luna, Terra, or Sol, then obtain a fresh Sol review.
interface.longDescription: Sol Advisor keeps GPT-5.6 Sol / High as the primary architect and router, prefers a native GPT-5.6 Luna / Max worker for bounded easy-to-medium implementation, escalates medium-to-hard work to GPT-5.6 Terra / High, uses a separate GPT-5.6 Sol / High implementation context for hard-to-complex execution, verifies the actual diff in the parent, and requires a fresh GPT-5.6 Sol / High final reviewer before completion.
defaultPrompt: Use Sol Advisor to plan with Sol / High and route implementation through the lowest capable native lane.
Prefer Luna for bounded work; escalate to Terra or a separate Sol implementer only when execution requires it.
Verify the actual diff and obtain a fresh Sol / High reviewer verdict before reporting completion.
